# Studio Riche Designs (Kerblabs concept site)

> Concept spec by Kerblabs for Studio Riche Designs, interior design in New Orleans, LA. Not the official site: https://www.studiorichedesigns.com/

## Facts (from their public site)
- Tagline: Designing personal spaces that inspire!
- Offers: Consultations (full tour of your home); Design in One Day (up to six hours of shopping alongside the client); Makeover Session (on-site 3-hour visit, client manages and installs); Designer on Call (10-hour minimum, 1-hour increments); Custom Interior Design Services
- Custom process: Initial Consultation; Design Proposal & Agreement; Design Concept; Design Presentation; Design Implementation & Completion
- Price: services start at $500
- Phone: (504) 905-0431
- Email: regina@studiorichedesigns.com
- Street address and hours: not published
- Machine-readable: services.json in this folder

## FAQ
- What do they do? Interior design in the New Orleans area, from one-day sessions to full custom projects.
- How to start? Email or call to schedule a call.
